column1: # The script modules (tools/modules/modules.tsv; a module of a level as level/Module): name, tag, why. Tags: DEF
# (classes, resources, the HUD skeleton, map elements, a level's sound loops: runs on both sides), SIM (NPCs,
# traffic, police, missions, activities: the server only), UI (menus, hangar, ship editor, conversor: the client,
# ending in a transaction the server checks), SCENE (scene tables: both sides, started by the server). The first
# tags were proposed by netclass.py --scan from the engine calls of each module's C file ("proposed: ..."), then
# A row Module.func tags one function of a mixed module (NetClass_ModuleTag looks it up before the module): the
# level start's functions and the class definitions that a -mp2 client calls (stage 3.3, include/scrap/initsteps.h).
